answer: Every new identity pays a 5 POA sybil tax, burned on entry, never refunded. A gardener selling willow cuttings pays once and trades for years, while a farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 5,000 POA up front and gains nothing, since each fake needs its own tax. A public beacon publishes tax rates and burn receipts each epoch, so anyone can check no identity entered free. Honest agents keep a haven: one tax, full access, no dilution from cheap clones.
